answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the marble graph and each risks its bond. Because the canyon release is written down with every signature, the garden audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
